dataset.attribution: Sibetan-v1 (27/10/2025), LIRMM/SEAdogSEA; published individual labels in gt_sibetan.json, not tracklet directory names. Eugênio Dias Ribeiro Neto et al., Background-invariant re-identification of dogs from camera-trap videos in non-controlled environments, Ecological Informatics (2025), DOI:10.1016/j.ecoinf.2025.103547.
dataset.protocol: Deterministic 5 development / 54 test identities: 50 positive queries, 50 gallery cases, 4 negative queries. One image per role/case. Equal experiment constants neutralize time/geography; these are not real event metadata. Cross-camera then cross-tracklet query selection, without viewing scores.
dataset.limitations: Dogs only, cropped camera-trap images from one location/week in 2019. Some pairs share a video/tracklet; repeated frames/background can inflate retrieval. No local Peruvian cases, cats, calibrated thresholds, deployment latency or identification probability is established.

metrics.limitations: No calibrated identity probability or automatic notification threshold. Operator must review dataset quality and results before activation.
